title: Met with patent attorneys for my game
author: Working-Spray-2933
selftext:
Basically my game has this utility that I have for reasons outside of gaming and there’s something I am aiming to protect. 

Why I am saying this, is to say that beyond gaming there are utilizations for certain inventions, even if it’s with AI and you can go on to try and protect them if you want, I.e. it’s not a lost cause so don’t be down on yourself if you make something and don’t want someone to copy it. 

I think if people use AI, because they can build things , if you cannot patent it, then you may be able to license it and don’t think that you are not capable of licensing a project. I hope everyone takes their work as to be their proprietary work/information. 

The future will be based on proprietary software,

You should not be getting downvotes and yes you should be vague about what you created.
